nodes.name: web_template.js
nodes.summary: Small helper exposing frappe.utils.get_web_template_map which fetches web template metadata via frappe.db.get_list for use in form controls and builders.

nodes.name: breadcrumbs.js
nodes.summary: Manages the top navigation breadcrumbs for Desk pages. Builds breadcrumb trails from DocType meta, module, and workspace context, caches modules, and renders Home/Workspace/List/Form links.

nodes.name: calendar.js
nodes.summary: Calendar view implementation built on FullCalendar. Defines frappe.views.CalendarView (a ListView subclass for routing) and frappe.views.Calendar (the renderer handling event fetch, create/drag/resize, color, and recurring events).

nodes.name: communication.js
nodes.summary: The email/comment composer dialog on forms. Provides frappe.views.CommunicationComposer to build a dialog with recipients, CC/BCC, subject, body editor, attachments, email templates, print format selection, and send/save-as-draft actions.

nodes.name: container.js
nodes.summary: Top-level page container for the Desk. frappe.views.Container manages page stack, page switching, hide/show of pages inside #body, and binds route change events to display the correct page.

nodes.name: dashboard_view.js
nodes.summary: Dashboard View renderer extending ListView. Loads a Dashboard doc, builds chart and number-card widgets, handles layout, edit mode, refresh actions, and customization via widget groups.

nodes.name: factory.js
nodes.summary: Base Factory class for view factories (List, Form, Report, etc.). Handles show/make logic per route and exposes frappe.make_page helper to construct a generic Desk page.

nodes.name: file_view.js
nodes.summary: File manager view extending ListView. Renders folder/file tree and grid, supports navigation into folders, drag-and-drop upload, rename/move, preview, and bulk actions.

nodes.name: formview.js
nodes.summary: FormFactory extending base Factory. Instantiates frappe.ui.form.Form for a given doctype/name route, handles form caching per doctype layout, and delegates to show_doc.

nodes.name: gantt_view.js
nodes.summary: Gantt chart view extending ListView. Wraps frappe-gantt library to render tasks with start/end/progress, supports drag to update dates, and view modes (Day/Week/Month).

nodes.name: CalendarView
nodes.summary: ListView subclass that wires calendar route handling, loads calendar settings for a doctype, and instantiates frappe.views.Calendar as its renderer.

nodes.name: Calendar
nodes.summary: FullCalendar wrapper: configures views, fetches events via a whitelisted get_events method, handles event click/create/drag/resize, color rules, and recurring events.

nodes.name: CommunicationComposer
nodes.summary: Dialog controller for composing emails/comments on a document. Builds fields, loads email templates, handles attachments, print formats, auto-fetch CC, send/save-as-draft, and error handling.

nodes.name: Container
nodes.summary: Desk page container that manages visible pages inside #body, handles route-based page switching, and triggers page show/hide events.

nodes.name: DashboardView
nodes.summary: ListView subclass rendering a Dashboard doc via chart and number-card widget groups, with edit mode, refresh, and customization actions.

nodes.name: Factory
nodes.summary: Base class for route-driven view factories. Defines show() which creates the page on first route and delegates to subclass make().

nodes.name: FileView
nodes.summary: File manager ListView subclass that adds folder navigation, grid rendering, upload/rename/move actions, and preview handling.

nodes.name: FormFactory
nodes.summary: Factory subclass that creates/reuses frappe.ui.form.Form instances per doctype layout and routes show_doc for form view URLs.

nodes.name: GanttView
nodes.summary: ListView subclass that renders a frappe-gantt chart from list data, handling task mapping, date changes, progress updates, and view modes.

nodes.name: get_web_template_map
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches a map of Web Template names to metadata for use in selectable template fields.

nodes.name: make_page
nodes.summary: Helper that builds and returns a new frappe.ui.Page inside the container with optional double-column layout and sidebar.
